from expense_tracker_api_sdk import ExpenseTrackerApiSdk, Environment
from expense_tracker_api_sdk.models import CreateCategoryRequest

    access_token="YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN",

    timeout=10
)

    name="Travel",
    receipt_threshold=50,

)
